race_description.description: Human humanoid anatomy: one torso, head and back; two arms and hands; a paired-feet group. Physical mutations require their actual body variant.
race_description.description_kind: Source-derived anatomy summary; native Humanoid has no race-wide Description.Short. No occupation or named posture inferred.

captured_actor.description:
He is a wind-carved man with the posture of a vinereaper; his spine is bent to point the bright turquoise of his eyes at the tilling angle, his hips are pushed odd-forward with the slumping ease of a stance much more relaxed than his. If it weren't for the salt on his brow and the scarred knuckles, he would seem a marble Saad perched under a crumbling tomb.
{{C|-----}}
Loved by {{C|the villagers of Joppa}}.

Disliked by {{C|the Seekers of the Sightless Way}} for leading a raiding party on one of their camps.

Disliked by {{C|mysterious strangers}} for torching one of their villages.

equipped.description:
A coarse flax waist is cinched with a watervine hemp rope.

{{K|Weight: 5 lbs.}}

A pair of strapped shoes are cracked on the soles in sinelike patterns of gravel walking.

{{K|Weight: 1 lbs.}}

boundaries.palette: Body authoring preview uses the captured actor Render palette, independently of each real item palette; this is not native biological skin metadata.
boundaries.ownership: Late original-body coverage is local to each item. Retain whole item textures and full body; never draw a whole-body overlay above unrelated equipment.
